mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message_stat ( total_send_count, total_success_count, billing_cost, max_cost, stat_date, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted ) SELECT NVL(SUM(sh.total_target_count), 0), NVL(SUM(sh.success_count), 0), NVL(SUM(sh.actual_cost), 0), NVL(SUM(sh.estimated_cost), 0), #{statDate}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{systemUserId}, #{systemUserId}, 0 FROM send_history sh WHERE sh.status = 'SENT' AND sh.completed_at >= CAST(#{statDate} AS TIMESTAMP) AND sh.completed_at < CAST(#{statDate} AS TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1' DAY AND NVL(sh.is_deleted, 0) = 0

mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO message_stat_by_degree ( degree, send_count, success_count, stat_date, cost, channel_id, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted ) SELECT -- 몇 차 발송인지. 예: 1차, 2차 sa.attempt_order,
-- 해당 차수/채널로 발송을 시도한 전체 건수 COUNT(sa.id),
-- 해당 차수/채널 발송 시도 중 성공한 건수 SUM(CASE WHEN sa.is_succeeded = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
-- 배치가 집계하는 기준 날짜 #{statDate},
-- 성공한 발송 시도에 대해서만 채널 단가를 합산한 비용 NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN sa.is_succeeded = 1 THEN c.cost_per_msg ELSE 0 END), 0),
-- 발송 시도에 사용된 채널 sa.channel_id, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{systemUserId}, #{systemUserId}, 0 FROM send_attempt sa -- send_attempt는 send_target_id를 통해 발송 대상과 연결된다. INNER JOIN send_target st ON st.id = sa.send_target_id AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 -- send_target은 send_history_id를 통해 발송 묶음과 연결된다. INNER JOIN send_history sh ON sh.id = st.send_history_id AND NVL(sh.is_deleted, 0) = 0 -- channel은 채널 단가(cost_per_msg)를 계산하기 위해 연결한다. INNER JOIN channel c ON c.id = sa.channel_id AND NVL(c.is_deleted, 0) = 0 -- 완료된 발송 묶음만 통계에 포함한다. WHERE sh.status = 'SENT' -- completed_at은 시간까지 포함하므로 당일 시작 이상, 다음날 시작 미만으로 비교한다. AND sh.completed_at >= CAST(#{statDate} AS TIMESTAMP) AND sh.completed_at < CAST(#{statDate} AS TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1' DAY AND NVL(sa.is_deleted, 0) = 0 -- 차수와 채널별로 한 row씩 집계한다. GROUP BY sa.attempt_order, sa.channel_id

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_stat ( stat_date, total_customer_count, normal_customer_count, new_customer_count, dormant_customer_count, sms_consent_count, kakao_consent_count, email_consent_count, joined_customer_count, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted ) WITH customer_counts AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customer_count, SUM(CASE WHEN c.joined_at < CAST(#{statDate} AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL '7' DAY AND ( c.last_active_at IS NULL OR c.last_active_at >= ADD_MONTHS(CAST(#{statDate} AS TIMESTAMP), -12) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS normal_customer_count, SUM(CASE WHEN c.joined_at >= CAST(#{statDate} AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL '7' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new_customer_count, SUM(CASE WHEN c.joined_at < CAST(#{statDate} AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL '7' DAY AND c.last_active_at < ADD_MONTHS(CAST(#{statDate} AS TIMESTAMP), -12) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dormant_customer_count, SUM(CASE WHEN c.joined_at >= CAST(#{statDate} AS TIMESTAMP) AND c.joined_at < CAST(#{statDate} AS TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS joined_customer_count FROM customer c WHERE NVL(c.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND c.joined_at < CAST(#{statDate} AS TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1' DAY ), consent_counts AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'SMS' THEN ccc.customer_id END) AS sms_consent_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'KAKAO' THEN ccc.customer_id END) AS kakao_consent_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'EMAIL' THEN ccc.customer_id END) AS email_consent_count FROM customer_channel_consent ccc INNER JOIN customer c ON c.id = ccc.customer_id AND NVL(c.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND c.joined_at < CAST(#{statDate} AS TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1' DAY INNER JOIN channel ch ON ch.id = ccc.channel_id AND NVL(ch.is_deleted, 0) = 0 WHERE NVL(ccc.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND NVL(ccc.is_consented, 0) = 1 ) SELECT #{statDate}, NVL(customer_counts.total_customer_count, 0), NVL(customer_counts.normal_customer_count, 0), NVL(customer_counts.new_customer_count, 0), NVL(customer_counts.dormant_customer_count, 0), NVL(consent_counts.sms_consent_count, 0), NVL(consent_counts.kakao_consent_count, 0), NVL(consent_counts.email_consent_count, 0), NVL(customer_counts.joined_customer_count, 0), SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{systemUserId}, #{systemUserId}, 0 FROM customer_counts customer_counts CROSS JOIN consent_counts consent_counts
mapper.update: UPDATE channel_stat SET is_deleted = 1, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{systemUserId} WHERE NVL(is_deleted, 0) = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO channel_stat ( click_target_count, click_count, conversion_target_count, conversion_count, consent_target_count, consent_count, channel_id, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted ) SELECT NVL(url_stat.click_target_count, 0), NVL(url_stat.click_count, 0), NVL(url_stat.conversion_target_count, 0), NVL(url_stat.conversion_count, 0), NVL(consent_stat.consent_target_count, 0), NVL(consent_stat.consent_count, 0), ch.id, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{systemUserId}, #{systemUserId}, 0 FROM channel ch LEFT JOIN ( SELECT st.final_channel_id AS channel_id, COUNT(su.id) AS click_target_count, SUM(CASE WHEN su.is_clicked = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS click_count, COUNT(su.id) AS conversion_target_count, SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(su.is_converted, 0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS conversion_count FROM short_url su INNER JOIN send_target st ON st.id = su.send_target_id AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 INNER JOIN send_history sh ON sh.id = st.send_history_id AND NVL(sh.is_deleted, 0) = 0 WHERE NVL(su.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND sh.status = 'SENT' AND st.final_channel_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY st.final_channel_id ) url_stat ON url_stat.channel_id = ch.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ccc.channel_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.customer_id) AS consent_target_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NVL(ccc.is_consented, 0) = 1 THEN ccc.customer_id END) AS consent_count FROM customer_channel_consent ccc INNER JOIN customer c ON c.id = ccc.customer_id AND NVL(c.is_deleted, 0) = 0 WHERE NVL(ccc.is_deleted, 0) = 0 GROUP BY ccc.channel_id ) consent_stat ON consent_stat.channel_id = ch.id WHERE NVL(ch.is_deleted, 0) = 0

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO click_stat ( id, stat_date, channel_id, hour_00, hour_01, hour_02, hour_03, hour_04, hour_05, hour_06, hour_07, hour_08, hour_09, hour_10, hour_11, hour_12, hour_13, hour_14, hour_15, hour_16, hour_17, hour_18, hour_19, hour_20, hour_21, hour_22, hour_23, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted ) SELECT CLICK_STAT_SEQ.NEXTVAL, aggregated.stat_date, aggregated.channel_id, aggregated.hour_00, aggregated.hour_01, aggregated.hour_02, aggregated.hour_03, aggregated.hour_04, aggregated.hour_05, aggregated.hour_06, aggregated.hour_07, aggregated.hour_08, aggregated.hour_09, aggregated.hour_10, aggregated.hour_11, aggregated.hour_12, aggregated.hour_13, aggregated.hour_14, aggregated.hour_15, aggregated.hour_16, aggregated.hour_17, aggregated.hour_18, aggregated.hour_19, aggregated.hour_20, aggregated.hour_21, aggregated.hour_22, aggregated.hour_23, aggregated.created_at, aggregated.updated_at, aggregated.created_by, aggregated.updated_by, aggregated.is_deleted FROM ( SELECT #{statDate} AS stat_date, ch.id AS channel_id, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN click_hour = 0 THEN click_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_00, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN click_hour = 1 THEN click_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_01, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN click_hour = 2 THEN click_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_02, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN click_hour = 3 THEN click_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_03, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN click_hour = 4 THEN click_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_04, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN click_hour = 5 THEN click_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_05, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN click_hour = 6 THEN click_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_06, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN click_hour = 7 THEN click_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_07, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN click_hour = 8 THEN click_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_08, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN click_hour = 9 THEN click_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_09, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN click_hour = 10 THEN click_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_10, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN click_hour = 11 THEN click_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_11, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN click_hour = 12 THEN click_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_12, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN click_hour = 13 THEN click_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_13, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN click_hour = 14 THEN click_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_14, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN click_hour = 15 THEN click_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_15, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN click_hour = 16 THEN click_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_16, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN click_hour = 17 THEN click_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_17, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN click_hour = 18 THEN click_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_18, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN click_hour = 19 THEN click_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_19, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN click_hour = 20 THEN click_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_20, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN click_hour = 21 THEN click_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_21, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN click_hour = 22 THEN click_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_22, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN click_hour = 23 THEN click_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS hour_23, SYSTIMESTAMP AS created_at, SYSTIMESTAMP AS updated_at, #{systemUserId} AS created_by, #{systemUserId} AS updated_by, 0 AS is_deleted FROM channel ch LEFT JOIN ( SELECT st.final_channel_id AS channel_id, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM su.clicked_at) AS click_hour, COUNT(*) AS click_count FROM short_url su INNER JOIN send_target st ON st.id = su.send_target_id AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 INNER JOIN send_history sh ON sh.id = st.send_history_id AND NVL(sh.is_deleted, 0) = 0 WHERE NVL(su.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND su.is_clicked = 1 AND su.clicked_at IS NOT NULL AND su.clicked_at >= CAST(#{statDate} AS TIMESTAMP) AND su.clicked_at < CAST(#{statDate} AS TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1' DAY AND sh.status = 'SENT' AND st.final_channel_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY st.final_channel_id, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM su.clicked_at) ) click_hour_stat ON click_hour_stat.channel_id = ch.id WHERE NVL(ch.is_deleted, 0) = 0 GROUP BY ch.id ) aggregated

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO template_stat ( template_id, template_rank, stat_date, template_count, click_target_count, click_count, conversion_target_count, conversion_count, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted ) SELECT template_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY CASE WHEN click_target_count = 0 THEN 0 ELSE click_count / click_target_count END DESC, click_count DESC, template_id ASC ) AS template_rank, #{statDate}, send_count, click_target_count, click_count, conversion_target_count, conversion_count, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{systemUserId}, #{systemUserId}, 0 FROM ( SELECT send_aggregated.template_id, send_aggregated.send_count, NVL(url_aggregated.click_target_count, 0) AS click_target_count, NVL(url_aggregated.click_count, 0) AS click_count, NVL(url_aggregated.conversion_target_count, 0) AS conversion_target_count, NVL(url_aggregated.conversion_count, 0) AS conversion_count FROM ( SELECT sh.template_id, NVL(SUM(sh.total_target_count), 0) AS send_count FROM send_history sh WHERE sh.status = 'SENT' AND sh.template_id IS NOT NULL AND sh.completed_at >= CAST(#{statDate} AS TIMESTAMP) AND sh.completed_at < CAST(#{statDate} AS TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1' DAY AND NVL(sh.is_deleted, 0) = 0 GROUP BY sh.template_id ) send_aggregated LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sh.template_id, COUNT(su.id) AS click_target_count, SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(su.is_clicked, 0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS click_count, COUNT(su.id) AS conversion_target_count, SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(su.is_converted, 0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS conversion_count FROM send_history sh LEFT JOIN send_target st ON st.send_history_id = sh.id AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 LEFT JOIN short_url su ON su.send_target_id = st.id AND NVL(su.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND NVL(su.purpose, 'CLICK') IN ('CLICK', 'PURCHASE') WHERE sh.status = 'SENT' AND sh.template_id IS NOT NULL AND sh.completed_at >= CAST(#{statDate} AS TIMESTAMP) AND sh.completed_at < CAST(#{statDate} AS TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1' DAY AND NVL(sh.is_deleted, 0) = 0 GROUP BY sh.template_id ) url_aggregated ON url_aggregated.template_id = send_aggregated.template_id ) template_aggregated
